svg.title: Topograph Engine Output Overview
svg.desc: Topograph engine output overview showing selectable topology inputs, Topograph core discovery, normalization, and publishing, and the scheduler-specific outputs published by the k8s, nfd, slinky, slurm, and graph engines.
svg.text: Each /v1/generate request selects one provider path and one output engine

text.tspan: Selected provider may combine fabric discovery

svg.text: one selected engine publishes one target output
Solid: requests, topology data, and generated outputs
Dashed: optional triggers or Kubernetes watches
